baseline.quantity: all original supports on initial owner sets

joint.scoring: gain_i = J(Y)-min_y J(Y with only i changed), ignoring feasibility for scoring; score_i=gain_i*(1+120*P_owner/max(1,T-L3_owner)); absent owner pressure zero
joint.anchor: rank step modulo n in freshly descending score, station index breaks ties
joint.released: all supported stock and all eligible owners on the block, including activation, zero, direction change and non-equal net transfers
joint.fixed: every outside Y and nonzero service owner; complete outside P/D/return retained
joint.acceptance: strict original-J decrease >1e-10 plus complete rounded resource predicate; independent exact original-T full D_R readback before reporting U_R
joint.termination: 12 blocks or ordinary whole-method deadline, no time-triggered algorithm switch; no nondecreasing move
joint.scope: bounded inner domains, no global lower/proof consumption

completion.method: same subset,last DP for both load-constrained and unloaded tours
completion.orders: all elementary visit orders with fixed Y/owner

deepening: choose at most one E path only after saved D evidence; record object, decision and capacity before execution
F: conditional on useful physical/global proof benefit, plausible self-paid cost, and qualified integrated C++ candidate; no offline-witness injection
